L109: Song with most wins  | "【38†INVU】" by 【39†Taeyeon】 & "【40†After Like】" by 【41†Ive】 (4)
L110: Artist(s) with most wins  | Ive (7)
L111: Song with highest score  | "【42†Beatbox】" by 【43†NCT Dream】 (9,800)
L112: 
L113: The Show! Music Core Chart is a 【44†record chart】 on the South Korean 【45†MBC】 television music program 【46†Show! Music Core】. Every week, the show awards the best-performing 【47†single】 on the chart in the country during its live broadcast.
L114: In 2022, 21 singles achieved number one on the chart, and 17 acts were awarded first-place trophies. "【42†Beatbox】" by 【43†NCT Dream】 had the highest score of the year, with 9,800 points on the June 11 broadcast. 【39†Taeyeon】's "【38†INVU】" and 【41†Ive】's "【40†After Like】" won four trophies each, making both singles the most-awarded songs of the year. "【48†Eleven】" and "After Like" by Ive spent a combined total of seven weeks atop the chart, making them the most awarded act of 2022.
L115: 【43†NCT Dream】's (pictured) win for "Beatbox" had the highest score of 2022, with 9,800 points at the June 11th broadcast
L116: ## Chart history
L117: 
L118: [【49†edit】]
L119: 
L120: 【50†Fromis 9】 (top), 【51†NewJeans】 (middle), and 【52†Le Sserafim】 (bottom) received their first Show! Music Core trophies for "【53†Stay This Way】," "【54†Attention】," and "【55†Antifragile】," respectively.
L121: 
L122: 【56†Twice】's 【57†Nayeon】 (pictured) won Show! Music Core for the first time with "【58†Pop!】."
L123: The Gaya-G unit (【59†Lee Bo-ram】 (upper left), 【60†Laboum】's 【61†Soyeon】 (upper right), 【62†Hynn】 (lower left), and 【63†Jung Ji-so】 (lower right)) of the 【64†Hangout with Yoo】 project group 【65†WSG Wannabe】 received their first music show trophy for "At That Moment" at Show! Music Core. The win also served as Hynn and Jung Ji-so's first time placing first at a music show.
